name: GNU MPC
reason: No numeric comparison in any reachable source. Boost.Multiprecision's performance docs (opened) say its header-only backends, including cpp_complex, are slower than the GMP-based 'MPC' libraries but give no MPC timings; the Arb paper (arXiv 1611.02831) has an acb versus MPC 1.0.3 table where MPC is the baseline, and its text was not reachable (arxiv.org blocked). multiprecision.org, gitlab.inria.fr and www.gnu.org ENOTFOUND.

name: GNU MPRIA
listed_description: Portable mathematics library for multi-precision rational
reason: No benchmark or speed claim found. Search results show only the manual and README: a GPL rational interval arithmetic library built on GMP and modelled on MPFI; the project pages (gnu.org) were not reachable from this sandbox (ENOTFOUND) and no third-party comparison turned up.
